decisions.reason: After another year on the market without any visible negative signal, this core rye bread appears to meet aspiration levels and uses existing capabilities with little strain, so management would keep it.
As a flagship seasonal product with gold-medal recognition, the premium raisin stollen provides a strong above-aspiration cue and is very unlikely to be withdrawn.
The seeded rye mixed bread remains close to the established assortment and, absent evidence of underperformance, boundedly rational management would continue it within the bread range.

This darker malt rye bread is still somewhat more niche and partly overlapping with other rye products, but with no clear shortfall relative to aspirations the firm would more likely retain than drop it.

The marzipan Christmas stollen fits the firm’s seasonal confectionery strengths, and without signs that it falls below internal or comparable-market aspirations management would keep it in the holiday portfolio.
